title: Knobby Crunchy Irish Lamb Skewers
description: Garlicky and crunchy Irish dish featuring elderflower and mushimono-steam, perfect for a special occasion, this fodmap-friendly recipe is sure to impress
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together elderflower syrup, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
While the lamb is baking, steam the crunchy potato sticks in a steamer basket for 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the oven and brush with additional elderflower syrup if desired.
Serve the lamb skewers with steamed potato sticks and garnish with chopped parsley.
